name: AlphaPeptDeep MS2 Model (MSNet 40M)
description: AlphaPeptDeep MS2 spectrum prediction model trained on 40M PSMs from the MSNet collection. Predicts fragment ion intensities for peptide-spectrum matching.

name: AutoRT Retention Time Model
description: AutoRT deep learning model for peptide retention time prediction, trained on MSNet collection data across multiple LC-MS platforms.

name: GPTime Retention Time Model
description: GPTime Gaussian Process-based retention time prediction model. Large-scale model trained on the MSNet collection.

name: HelixNovo HLA De Novo Sequencing
description: HelixNovo de novo peptide sequencing model specialized for HLA/immunopeptidomics, trained on MSNet data.

name: HelixNovo Metaproteomics De Novo Sequencing
description: HelixNovo de novo sequencing model for metaproteomics samples, trained on MSNet multi-species data.

name: HelixNovo Phosphoproteomics De Novo Sequencing
description: HelixNovo de novo sequencing model specialized for phosphopeptide identification.
